integrity: All listed arithmetic identities have an explicit proof and an independent finite-field verification program. The initial Cartier rank and a-number are compatible with earlier general superelliptic results and are not separately claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies the stated coefficient-marked genus-four cyclic triple covers, not isomorphism classes. The p-rank-zero locus is asserted set-theoretically, with no determinantal scheme-multiplicity claim; no Newton polygon, supersingularity, or full Ekedahl–Oort type is asserted.
title: An exact characteristic-two rank stratification for a genus-four cyclic trigonal family
